parameters.formDescription: Review a possible supplier invoice product match and approve or reject the proposed match.

values.placeholder: Enter the reason for your decision

parameters.query:
WITH approval_update AS (
    UPDATE public.approvals
    SET
        status = 'APPROVED',
        decided_by = $5::text,
        decided_at = now(),
        decision_notes = $6::text,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND organization_id = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'PENDING'
      AND approval_type = 'ANOMALY_REVIEW'

    RETURNING
        id,
        organization_id,
        anomaly_id,
        invoice_id
),

invoice_item_update AS (
    UPDATE public.invoice_items ii
    SET
        product_id = $4::uuid,
        purchase_order_item_id = $7::uuid,
        updated_at = now()

    FROM approval_update au

    WHERE ii.id = $3::uuid
      AND ii.organization_id = au.organization_id
      AND ii.invoice_id = au.invoice_id

    RETURNING
        ii.id AS invoice_item_id,
        ii.invoice_id,
        ii.organization_id,
        ii.product_id,
        ii.purchase_order_item_id,
        ii.invoiced_quantity,
        ii.unit_price,
        ii.line_total
),

anomaly_update AS (
    UPDATE public.anomalies a
    SET
        status = 'RESOLVED',
        reviewed_at = COALESCE(a.reviewed_at, now()),
        resolved_at = now(),
        reviewed_by = $5::text,
        resolution_notes = $6::text,
        updated_at = now()

    FROM approval_update au

    WHERE a.id = au.anomaly_id
      AND a.organization_id = au.organization_id
      AND a.anomaly_type = 'PRODUCT_MATCH_REVIEW'

    RETURNING
        a.id AS anomaly_id,
        a.status AS anomaly_status
)

SELECT
    au.id AS approval_id,
    'APPROVED'::text AS approval_status,

    iu.invoice_item_id,
    iu.invoice_id,
    iu.organization_id,
    iu.product_id,
    iu.purchase_order_item_id,
    iu.invoiced_quantity,
    iu.unit_price,
    iu.line_total,

    an.anomaly_id,
    an.anomaly_status,

    $5::text AS decided_by,
    $6::text AS decision_notes

FROM approval_update au
JOIN invoice_item_update iu
    ON iu.invoice_id = au.invoice_id
   AND iu.organization_id = au.organization_id
JOIN anomaly_update an
    ON an.anomaly_id = au.anomaly_id;

SELECT
    ii.organization_id,
    ii.id AS invoice_item_id,
    ii.invoice_id,
    ii.product_id,
    ii.purchase_order_item_id,

    i.supplier_id,
    i.purchase_order_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.invoice_date,
    i.currency,

    ii.line_number AS invoice_line_number,
    ii.description_from_invoice AS invoice_description,
    ii.supplier_sku AS invoice_supplier_sku,
    ii.invoiced_quantity,
    ii.unit_price AS invoice_unit_price,
    ii.line_total AS invoice_line_total,

    p.sku AS product_sku,
    p.product_name,

    poi.line_number AS po_line_number,
    poi.ordered_quantity,
    poi.unit_price AS po_unit_price,

    sp.agreed_unit_price,
    sp.tolerance_percent,

    COALESCE(
        sp.agreed_unit_price,
        poi.unit_price
    ) AS expected_unit_price,

    ii.unit_price -
    COALESCE(
        sp.agreed_unit_price,
        poi.unit_price
    ) AS unit_price_variance,

    (
        ii.unit_price -
        COALESCE(
            sp.agreed_unit_price,
            poi.unit_price
        )
    ) * ii.invoiced_quantity AS price_variance_amount,

    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(sp.agreed_unit_price, poi.unit_price) > 0
        THEN ROUND(
            (
                (
                    ii.unit_price -
                    COALESCE(sp.agreed_unit_price, poi.unit_price)
                )
                /
                COALESCE(sp.agreed_unit_price, poi.unit_price)
            ) * 100,
            2
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS price_variance_percent,

    ii.invoiced_quantity - poi.ordered_quantity
        AS quantity_variance,

    CASE
        WHEN poi.ordered_quantity > 0
        THEN ROUND(
            (
                (ii.invoiced_quantity - poi.ordered_quantity)
                / poi.ordered_quantity
            ) * 100,
            2
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS quantity_variance_percent

FROM public.invoice_items ii

JOIN public.invoices i
    ON i.id = ii.invoice_id
   AND i.organization_id = ii.organization_id

JOIN public.products p
    ON p.id = ii.product_id
   AND p.organization_id = ii.organization_id

JOIN public.purchase_order_items poi
    ON poi.id = ii.purchase_order_item_id
   AND poi.organization_id = ii.organization_id

LEFT JOIN public.supplier_products sp
    ON sp.organization_id = ii.organization_id
   AND sp.supplier_id = i.supplier_id
   AND sp.product_id = ii.product_id
   AND sp.status = 'ACTIVE'
   AND sp.effective_from <= i.invoice_date
   AND (
       sp.effective_to IS NULL
       OR sp.effective_to >= i.invoice_date
   )

WHERE ii.id = $1::uuid
  AND ii.organization_id = $2::uuid

LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.anomalies (
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,

    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,

    expected_value,
    actual_value,
    variance_amount,
    variance_percent,
    estimated_financial_impact,

    description,
    evidence
)

SELECT
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    $3::uuid,
    $4::uuid,
    $5::uuid,
    $6::uuid,

    'PRICE_VARIANCE',

    CASE
        WHEN ABS($10::numeric) >= 50 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN ABS($10::numeric) >= 20 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN ABS($10::numeric) >= 10 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END,

    'OPEN',

    $7::numeric,
    $8::numeric,
    $9::numeric,
    $10::numeric,

    ABS($11::numeric),

    $12::text,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'invoice_number', $13::text,
        'invoice_line_number', $14::integer,
        'invoice_description', $15::text,
        'invoice_supplier_sku', $16::text,

        'product_sku', $17::text,
        'product_name', $18::text,

        'invoiced_quantity', $19::numeric,
        'ordered_quantity', $20::numeric,

        'expected_unit_price', $7::numeric,
        'invoice_unit_price', $8::numeric,

        'unit_price_variance', $9::numeric,
        'price_variance_percent', $10::numeric,
        'price_variance_amount', $11::numeric,

        'tolerance_percent', $21::numeric,
        'currency', $22::text,

        'detection_method',
        'APPROVED_PRODUCT_MATCH_PRICE_COMPARISON'
    )

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.anomalies a
    WHERE a.organization_id = $1::uuid
      AND a.invoice_id = $2::uuid
      AND a.invoice_item_id = $3::uuid
      AND a.anomaly_type = 'PRICE_VARIANCE'
)

RETURNING
    id AS anomaly_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,
    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,
    expected_value,
    actual_value,
    variance_amount,
    variance_percent,
    estimated_financial_impact,
    description,
    evidence,
    detected_at;

Expected unit price: ' +     $json.currency + ' ' + $json.expected_unit_price +     ', actual unit price: ' +     $json.currency + ' ' + $json.invoice_unit_price +     ', variance: ' +     $json.price_variance_percent + '%.',    $json.invoice_number,   $json.invoice_line_number,   $json.invoice_description,   $json.invoice_supplier_sku,    $json.product_sku,   $json.product_name,    $json.invoiced_quantity,   $json.ordered_quantity,    $json.tolerance_percent,   $json.currency ] }}

parameters.query:
WITH approval_update AS (
    UPDATE public.approvals
    SET
        status = 'REJECTED',
        decided_by = $3::text,
        decided_at = now(),
        decision_notes = $4::text,
        updated_at = now()

    WHERE id = $1::uuid
      AND organization_id = $2::uuid
      AND status = 'PENDING'
      AND approval_type = 'ANOMALY_REVIEW'

    RETURNING
        id,
        organization_id,
        anomaly_id,
        invoice_id
),

anomaly_update AS (
    UPDATE public.anomalies a
    SET
        status = 'RESOLVED',
        reviewed_at = COALESCE(a.reviewed_at, now()),
        resolved_at = now(),
        reviewed_by = $3::text,
        resolution_notes =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF($4::text, ''),
                'Proposed product match rejected by reviewer.'
            ),
        updated_at = now()

    FROM approval_update au

    WHERE a.id = au.anomaly_id
      AND a.organization_id = au.organization_id
      AND a.anomaly_type = 'PRODUCT_MATCH_REVIEW'

    RETURNING
        a.id AS anomaly_id,
        a.status AS anomaly_status
)

SELECT
    au.id AS approval_id,
    au.organization_id,
    au.invoice_id,
    au.anomaly_id,

    'REJECTED'::text AS approval_status,

    an.anomaly_status,

    $3::text AS decided_by,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF($4::text, ''),
        'Proposed product match rejected by reviewer.'
    ) AS decision_notes

FROM approval_update au

JOIN anomaly_update an
    ON an.anomaly_id = au.anomaly_id;

INSERT INTO public.anomalies (
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,

    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,

    estimated_financial_impact,
    description,
    evidence
)

SELECT
    a.organization_id,
    a.invoice_id,
    a.invoice_item_id,
    a.supplier_id,

    NULL,
    a.purchase_order_id,

    'UNKNOWN_PRODUCT',
    'HIGH',
    'OPEN',

    COALESCE(ii.line_total, 0),

    'Product match rejected by human reviewer. Invoice item "' ||
    COALESCE(ii.description_from_invoice, 'Unknown item') ||
    '" requires manual product resolution.',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'reason', 'REJECTED_PRODUCT_MATCH',

        'original_review_anomaly_id', a.id,
        'approval_id', ap.id,

        'invoice_line_number', ii.line_number,
        'invoice_description', ii.description_from_invoice,
        'invoice_supplier_sku', ii.supplier_sku,
        'invoice_quantity', ii.invoiced_quantity,
        'invoice_unit_price', ii.unit_price,
        'invoice_line_total', ii.line_total,

        'rejected_candidate_product_id', a.product_id,
        'rejected_candidate_product_name',
            a.evidence->>'candidate_product_name',

        'rejected_candidate_internal_sku',
            a.evidence->>'candidate_internal_sku',

        'rejected_candidate_po_item_id',
            a.evidence->>'candidate_po_item_id',

        'rejected_match_score',
            a.evidence->>'match_score',

        'reviewed_by', ap.decided_by,
        'review_notes', ap.decision_notes
    )

FROM public.approvals ap

JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.id = ap.anomaly_id
   AND a.organization_id = ap.organization_id

JOIN public.invoice_items ii
    ON ii.id = a.invoice_item_id
   AND ii.organization_id = a.organization_id
   AND ii.invoice_id = a.invoice_id

WHERE ap.id = $1::uuid
  AND ap.organization_id = $2::uuid
  AND ap.status = 'REJECTED'
  AND a.anomaly_type = 'PRODUCT_MATCH_REVIEW'

  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.anomalies existing
      WHERE existing.organization_id = a.organization_id
        AND existing.invoice_id = a.invoice_id
        AND existing.invoice_item_id = a.invoice_item_id
        AND existing.anomaly_type = 'UNKNOWN_PRODUCT'
        AND existing.status IN (
            'OPEN',
            'UNDER_REVIEW',
            'CONFIRMED'
        )
  )

RETURNING
    id AS anomaly_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,
    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,
    estimated_financial_impact,
    description,
    evidence,
    detected_at;

INSERT INTO public.anomalies (
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,
    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,
    expected_value,
    actual_value,
    variance_amount,
    variance_percent,
    estimated_financial_impact,
    description,
    evidence
)
SELECT
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    $3::uuid,
    $4::uuid,
    $5::uuid,
    $6::uuid,

    'QUANTITY_VARIANCE',

    CASE
        WHEN ABS($10::numeric) >= 50 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN ABS($10::numeric) >= 25 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN ABS($10::numeric) >= 10 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END,

    'OPEN',

    $7::numeric,
    $8::numeric,
    $9::numeric,
    $10::numeric,

    CASE
        WHEN $9::numeric > 0
        THEN $9::numeric * $11::numeric
        ELSE 0
    END,

    'Quantity variance detected on invoice "' ||
        $12::text ||
        '" line ' ||
        $13::text ||
        '. Ordered quantity: ' ||
        $7::text ||
        ', invoiced quantity: ' ||
        $8::text ||
        ', variance: ' ||
        $9::text ||
        '.',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'reason', 'INVOICED_QUANTITY_DIFFERS_FROM_PO',
        'invoice_number', $12::text,
        'invoice_line_number', $13::integer,
        'product_id', $5::uuid,
        'product_sku', $14::text,
        'product_name', $15::text,
        'purchase_order_item_id', $16::uuid,
        'ordered_quantity', $7::numeric,
        'invoiced_quantity', $8::numeric,
        'quantity_variance', $9::numeric,
        'quantity_variance_percent', $10::numeric,
        'unit_price', $11::numeric,
        'currency', $17::text,
        'detection_method', 'PO_VS_INVOICE_QUANTITY'
    )

WHERE ABS($9::numeric) > 0

AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.anomalies a
    WHERE a.organization_id = $1::uuid
      AND a.invoice_id = $2::uuid
      AND a.invoice_item_id = $3::uuid
      AND a.anomaly_type = 'QUANTITY_VARIANCE'
      AND a.status IN (
          'OPEN',
          'UNDER_REVIEW',
          'CONFIRMED'
      )
)

RETURNING
    id AS anomaly_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_id,
    invoice_item_id,
    supplier_id,
    product_id,
    purchase_order_id,
    anomaly_type,
    severity,
    status,
    expected_value,
    actual_value,
    variance_amount,
    variance_percent,
    estimated_financial_impact,
    description,
    evidence,
    detected_at;

SELECT
    i.id AS invoice_id,
    i.organization_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.processing_status AS current_status,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
    )::integer AS active_anomaly_count,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'OPEN'
    )::integer AS open_anomaly_count,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'UNDER_REVIEW'
    )::integer AS under_review_count,

    COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
        WHERE a.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    )::integer AS confirmed_count,

    COALESCE(
        SUM(a.estimated_financial_impact) FILTER (
            WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
        ),
        0
    ) AS active_financial_impact,

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
            WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
        ) > 0
        THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
        ELSE 'PROCESSED'
    END AS recommended_status

FROM public.invoices i

LEFT JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.invoice_id = i.id
   AND a.organization_id = i.organization_id

WHERE i.id = $1::uuid
  AND i.organization_id = $2::uuid

GROUP BY
    i.id,
    i.organization_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.processing_status;

UPDATE public.invoices
SET
    processing_status = $3::text,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
  AND organization_id = $2::uuid
RETURNING
    id AS invoice_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_number,
    processing_status,
    updated_at;

SELECT
    ap.id AS approval_id,
    ap.organization_id,
    ap.anomaly_id,
    ap.invoice_id,
    ap.approval_type,
    ap.status AS approval_status,
    ap.requested_by,
    ap.requested_at,

    a.invoice_item_id,
    a.supplier_id,
    a.product_id AS candidate_product_id,
    a.purchase_order_id,
    a.anomaly_type,
    a.status AS anomaly_status,
    a.description AS anomaly_description,
    a.evidence,

    a.evidence->>'candidate_product_name'
        AS candidate_product_name,

    a.evidence->>'candidate_internal_sku'
        AS candidate_internal_sku,

    a.evidence->>'candidate_po_item_id'
        AS candidate_po_item_id,

    a.evidence->>'match_score'
        AS match_score,

    $2::text AS reviewer_name,
    $3::text AS review_decision,
    $4::text AS review_notes

FROM public.approvals ap

JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.id = ap.anomaly_id
   AND a.organization_id = ap.organization_id

WHERE ap.id = $1::uuid
  AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ap.approval_type = 'ANOMALY_REVIEW'
  AND a.anomaly_type = 'PRODUCT_MATCH_REVIEW'

LIMIT 1;

    ),

    jsonb_build_object(

SELECT
    i.id AS invoice_id,
    i.organization_id,

            WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
        ),
        0
    ) AS active_financial_impact,

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(a.id) FILTER (
            WHERE a.status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'CONFIRMED')
        ) > 0
        THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
        ELSE 'PROCESSED'
    END AS recommended_status

FROM public.invoices i

LEFT JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.invoice_id = i.id
    AND a.organization_id = i.organization_id

WHERE i.id = $1::uuid
  AND i.organization_id = $2::uuid

GROUP BY
    i.id,
    i.organization_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.processing_status;

UPDATE public.invoices
SET
    processing_status = $3::text,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
  AND organization_id = $2::uuid

RETURNING
    id AS invoice_id,
    organization_id,
    invoice_number,
    processing_status,
    updated_at;

INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
    organization_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    action,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    source,
    description,
    old_values,
    new_values,
    metadata
)
VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    'INVOICE',
    $2::uuid,
    'STATUS_CHANGE',
    'N8N',
    'PROCUREGUARD_N8N',
    'PRODUCT_MATCH_REJECTION_WORKFLOW',

    'Invoice "' ||
    $3::text ||
    '" processing status changed from "PROCESSING" to "' ||
    $4::text ||
    '" after product match rejection.',

    jsonb_build_object(
        'processing_status', 'PROCESSING'
    ),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'processing_status', $4::text
    ),

    jsonb_build_object(
        'workflow', 'ProcureGuard AI - Product Match Approval',
        'decision_path', 'REJECT',
        'reason', 'REJECTED_PRODUCT_MATCH'
    )
)
RETURNING
    id AS audit_log_id,
    organization_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    action,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    source,
    description,
    old_values,
    new_values,
    metadata,
    created_at;
